text:
lee: prod: sudden KV prefix hit-rate collapse on prod-gpu-7, 04:10 UTC. hit-rate ~2% -> latency x3 on small-model routes. noticed coincident spike in eviction rate. Anyone seeing this?

maria: looking. Grafana shows TTL evictions up 10x. Any recent config changes?

lee: rolled a batching heuristic tweak ~03:58 (PR #4123) that changed prefetch accounting and kernel selection fallback. not sure it's the cause yet.

sam: I see a large rise in distinct prefix cardinality on that shard: top prefixes count jumped from 3k -> 180k in 2m. Could be namespace mixing.

olivia: ran a quick pprof on kv-service (attached):

sam: ```text
heap profile: 12.3MB -> allocations pinned to PrefetchManager.map[string]*entry
CPU: hot path in PrefetchManager.recordHit(false) -> keyNamespace(hash) -> oob string concat
```

anya: hmm we rotated tenant header parsing in 2111-release, we switched to concatenated tenant+route key for perf reasons. If tenant id empty we ended up with global empty namespace -> key collisions?

lee: tenant header absent in some legacy client -> keys collapsed to same namespace, causing one tenant to pollute cache and evict others. That matches noisy neighbor symptoms.

maria: confirm: logs show many requests with X-Tenant: "" starting 04:05. Source IPs traced to loadbalancer rule LB-legacy-2.

ops-bot: alert: kv-evictions-prod-gpu-7 high; page sent to eng-runtime@channel 04:12 UTC.

runtime-ci: deploy bot: rolled PR 4123 at 03:58 -> canary +5% then 50%. Reverting can help. PR link: https://git.redwood/rr/4123

sam: short mitigation: disabled prefetcher and set kv.prefetch.enabled=false on prod-gpu-7 (rolled to all nodes) at 04:25. Hitrate recovered partially to ~28% by 04:40. TTL bump also applied: kv.prefix_ttl=600 -> 1800 at 04:30.

olivia: perf profile after mitigation shows cache hot-set stabilizing and kernel fallback rate back to normal. still seeing some tail latency from in-flight evictions.

anya: next steps: revert PR 4123 from canary and audit tenant header handling; add defensive check to treat empty tenant as separate namespace id and enforce header validation at the edge LB.

lee: opening incident ticket INF-2531 and perf postmortem. Assigning: sam/anya/olivia.

maria: thanks. keeping watches for 24h. :thumbsup:

lee: note for postmortem: look at batching heuristic interplay with prefetch accounting and kernel selection heuristics (we observed kernel change frequency spike when hit-rate low).

sam: adding log snippet for repro:

sam: ```json
{"route":"small-model","tenant": "", "prefix":"/chat/abc","prefetch":true}
```

olivia: will run a sim with high-cardinality empty-tenant traffic to validate fix.

lee: good. closing thread unless we see recurrence.
